environment.description: Kubernetes deployment on EKS 1.28 cluster. Pod runs as root (UID 0) in a namespace with no PodSecurityPolicy or Pod Security Standards enforcement. Container image is based on ubuntu:22.04 with full coreutils, curl, wget, and netcat installed. The pod has hostPath volume mount to /var/run/docker.sock and runs with privileged: true in the securityContext. No network policies applied. Service exposed via NodePort.
